# dshloader
**Patch-specific dsh adapters, owned resources, and declarative plugin configuration.**
English | 简体中文
## English
dsh-loader **2.0.0** provides independent adapters for dsh patch releases, stable host capability fa
cades, client UI helpers, and a new configuration API with centrally generated forms.
Supported patch families: `0.1.5`, `0.1.6`, `0.1.7`, `0.2.0`, `0.2.1`, `0.2.2`, including prerelease
s. The published release inventory and dependency resolution are frozen on 2026-10-30. Unknown patch
es, majors, and older versions are rejected. Requires Node >=24.9.0.
### Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`setup` writes the dependency and Cordis patch to the named profile. Install the locally packed arch
ive into that same profile, then restart dsh. These commands do not publish the package.
Inject `dshLoader` to access `config`, `settings`, `web`, `services`, `registry`, `llm`, `dsh`, and
`patch`. The client entry is `@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader/client`; host module subpaths have explicit ESM
nt entry is `@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader/client`; host module subpaths have explicit ESM and CJS exports.
### Configuration
Register a JSON template through `config.register(ownerCtx, template)`. Values persist at `<profile>
/config/<pluginID>/config.json`, independently of host settings and `exposeAllNamespaces`. Templates
support groups, objects, arrays, passwords, validation, and declarative visibility.
Templates can also declare transient operation panels with host handlers registered through `handle.
registerOperation()`: async options, selection-to-editor bindings, editing/import, read-only Markdow
n/list/JSON results, cancellable long tasks, and resource revision conflicts. Operation drafts never
enter the configuration file.
Fields can also open custom dialogs registered by the client through `dshLoaderUi.config.registerDia
log()`. Plugins provide a React UI and a data reader; `.save()` and the Confirm button share revisio
n-checked configuration persistence, retaining editor contents on failure.
Before dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2, forms appear under More → Settings → Plugin configuration. Newer versions
use the corresponding native plugin detail page. Every plugin has a collapsed card with measured equ
al-width labels and fieldset groups. Save, cancel, and restore-defaults work per card; failed or con
flicting saves preserve drafts.
